summary: HINDENBURG DAY: report accused Adani Group of stock manipulation, claimed fair value ~15% of market price, disclosed shorts via US-traded bonds and non-Indian derivatives. Timing suspicious (eve of FPO opening, monthly expiry, after weeks of FII F&O buying while selling cash). Adani stocks hammered; SBI -4%+ on highest bank exposure; Bank Nifty -1,500 pts high-to-low in two sessions; every sector red. FIIs -Rs 2,400 cr, DIIs +Rs 1,370 cr; ~$3bn FII outflow in January. His own put positions forced firefighting at a loss; turns short-term bearish.

events.claim: Hindenburg Research released a report on Adani Group alleging stock manipulation and accounting fraud, valuing group stocks at ~15% of market price, and disclosed short positions via US-traded bonds and non-Indian-traded derivative instruments (24 Jan 2023)

lessons: When a large-group scandal breaks, sell first and question later - lender banks with group exposure fall next

summary: US rallied on strong GDP - a rare positive reaction, signalling Fed fears are easing; Dow up five straight.
